probes.probe: 1,500-page text PDF through the sandboxed extraction service
probes.detail: Phase 2 sandbox (extractor/sandbox.py Limits): 10 MB input cap checked before spawning, 50-page cap checked in the worker, CPU 30 s, wall 60 s, memory/file limits.
